title: NightSky OpenWeather alteration method offer
notice: OpenWeather data and the adapted OpenWeather sample component are offered under ODbL 1.0. This machine-readable method describes all alterations used to produce that component; unrelated providers and application code are outside this component.

source.credentials: Not included. lat/lon select the requested point.

algorithm: Validate cod 200 and list of 1 through 40 finite bounded steps against the implementation schema. Ignore unselected upstream properties.
Sort by integer Unix dt ascending. Duplicate dt values reject the response.
Select dt inclusively between requested startUtc and endUtc. Convert dt seconds to ISO UTC validAt. No interpolation, blending or extrapolation.
Copy supplied supported fields using the mappings below; missing values remain absent. Omit samples with no supported fields; reject if none remain.

Report missing fields across retained samples, upstream first/last validity, nonnegative hours from fetch time to last sample, partial status and native three-hour horizon/coverage gaps. No supported weather value is imputed.
For precipitation only, absent rain or snow contributes zero when the other is supplied. Period is dt minus 10800 seconds through dt.

precipitationAmount.period: preceding three hours ending at dt

omissionReason: pop interval bounds are unestablished for this JSON endpoint; other fields are unavailable.
sourceMetadata: Retain OpenWeather provider/product/documentation, ODbL link, credit, normalization notice and forecast uncertainty warning separately from other providers. No response cache retained.

credit.status: Official logo asset/use terms and legible linked actual-host rendering require release evidence; no logo is fabricated or bundled here.

validation.invalidResponse: Reject; never promote invalid input or stale samples to a successful forecast.
validation.window: Finite schema-valid UTC start/end and IANA timezone; point latitude/longitude schema validation precedes request.

coverage: No selected samples: out-of-horizon if window wholly before first or after last upstream dt, otherwise not-covered. Gap flag if first dt > requested start, last dt < requested end, any consecutive upstream dt differ from 10800 seconds, or any selected sample is empty and omitted. Successful forecast always partial.
